department: School of Chemistry, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology (CCEB) — Chemistry

deadline.value: August 2027 (Semester 1) intake closes January 31, 2027 (portal opens October 1; January intake closes July 31).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for chemistry (discontinued in May 2023).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: NTU strongly recommends contacting a potential supervisor before applying; otherwise the School assigns a supervisor based on research interests.
supervisor.quote: It is highly recommended that you seek out a potential supervisor prior to submitting your application. Alternatively, if you have not identified one, the School will appoint a supervisor based on your research interests.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a relevant bachelor's degree with minimum Honours (Distinction / Upper Second Class Honours); a master's degree is not mandatory.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should possess a good relevant Bachelor’s degree with Honours, with a minimum of Distinction, Upper Second Class Honours or its equivalent. A Master’s degree is not mandatory.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS may be waived if the applicant provides documentary proof (such as an official letter or certificate) that English was the medium of instruction during tertiary studies.
english_waiver.quote: This requirement may be waived if the applicant can provide documentary proof, normally in the form of a letter or certificate, that English was the medium of instruction during their tertiary studies.

notes: CCEB PhD applicants must also submit a short video essay alongside two academic references and research proposal.
